items.heading: Irish Stew
details: Key ingredients: lamb, potato, carrot, onion, barley
Brown lamb pieces lightly, then set aside.
Layer the lamb with potato, carrot and onion in a heavy pot.
Add barley and enough water to just cover.
Simmer slowly until the meat is tender and the broth has thickened.

items.heading: Colcannon
details: Key ingredients: potato, cabbage or kale, butter, milk, scallion
Boil potatoes until tender, then mash with butter and milk.
Cook shredded cabbage or kale until soft.
Fold the greens and chopped scallion into the mashed potato.
Serve warm with an extra pat of butter melting on top.
